name: Down Wind
body:
You can use a bit of troglodyte magic to direct your stench around the field of battle.

Prerequisites: Character level 5th, troglodyte, troglodyte stench racial trait.

Benefit: Your stench acts as a stinking cloud spell that you can direct to move up to 10 feet with a move or standard action, or up to 20 feet as a full-round action.
